headline: Orient Ceratech Limited files substantial acquisition disclosure under SEBI Takeover Regulations
sum: Orient Ceratech Limited has submitted a Regulation 31(4) disclosure to NSE, signalling a substantial acquisition of shares or an announcement of intent under the SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011.
detail: Orient Ceratech Limited has filed a mandatory disclosure under Regulation 31(4) of the SEBI Takeover Regulations, 2011, with the NSE. This regulation requires disclosure when a person or group acquires shares or voting rights such that their holding reaches or crosses material thresholds (typically 25%, 50%, or 75%). The filing does not specify the acquiring party, shareholding percentage, or consideration; these details appear in the full disclosure document submitted to the exchange. The disclosure sets off a cascade of takeover-code requirements including trading window closures and mandatory open offer triggers if applicable.
